name: Single-Leg Stand

instructions.description: Stand tall near a wall or chair for safety if needed.
Shift your weight onto one foot and slowly lift the other foot off the floor.
Keep the pelvis level and look at a fixed point in front of you while breathing normally.
Lower the lifted foot with control and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold each side with quality posture.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other if single-leg stance is too difficult.

commentsNotes: Do not lock the standing knee.
